Press 1, 2 or 3, or pick a page. From the experiments, ← Menu brings you back here.

Settings

Controls for the whole sandbox, whichever page you're on. The little world beside them shows what each does as you change it.

The most pictures drawn a second, for everything: the worlds and this one. Fewer is lighter on the computer and its battery; more is smoother, as far as your screen can show it.

How often every line is drawn afresh, like animation on paper: still, or a slow boil, or a busy one.

How far the pen strays from the true edge of things: steady, or a shakier hand.

How far off the pen starts drawing finer, lighter lines, so things in the distance and small things aren't lost under their outlines. Nearer for a lighter, airier drawing; further for bold ink all the way back.

How much air you see things through: far things paler, bluer, softer and drawn with a lighter pen, so near and far separate. None for a flat drawing; more for a hazier day.

How wide you see when walking about, top to bottom (side to side is wider, by the window's shape). Wider takes in more around you and makes near things feel near; narrower is calmer, like a longer lens. Looking on from above stays at 42°.

The painting can't start

This sandbox needs WebGL2. Try a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
